purpose: Prepare the fixed Linux process backend and durable journal connection; do not run a new remote or container validation under exhausted E75 quota

fixed_backend.kernel_gates: Exact reused preflight: Linux PID 1 and matching proc view, dedicated cgroup v2, memory128MiB, swap0, pids16, observed OOM group0/1, no pre-existing descendants
fixed_backend.subreaper: Required before launch and after actual kernel preflight; no shell or host cgroup write
fixed_backend.scratch: Backend-owned new /tmp directory only after preflight; no caller-selected working directory
fixed_backend.child: Fixed reviewed Python payload with new session, inherited stdin/stdout/stderr disabled as in E75
fixed_backend.identity: Internally observed host, boot ID, PID, start ticks and PGID bound to owned handle; never caller flags as kernel proof
fixed_backend.cleanup: Reuse reviewed cleanup_group on own known handle; confirm reaping and empty group. Failure on identity acquisition cleans internally before error propagation.
fixed_backend.unknown_spawn: No reliable handle means incomplete and no retry; never synthesize absence or a successful reap

journal.same_phase_backend_identity: Do not switch backend instances mid-phase to reset profile consumption; all LAUNCHED records must share the first accepted host and boot ID
journal.interval: Before INTENT append to after cleanup and before terminal append; includes intent/identity ACK, dispatch/checks, wait and cleanup. Not atomic ATPG process time or full end-to-end search cost.
journal.incomplete: Any unknown launch, identity, cleanup or acknowledgment uncertainty makes whole usable interval sum null and stops the phase
journal.replay: Strict bounded canonical hashchain replay, never proof of original fsync ACK, source authenticity or OS execution
journal.provenance: E75 remains historical reference only; no invented retrospective v3 journal or timestamps

current_validation.type: Local mock tests only; patch Popen/preflight/kernel calls, do not launch v3 children
current_validation.process_summary: Use observed identity records and unresolved intents, not an inherited static actual_processes=0 claim on a real-capable adapter

required_tests: exact fixed Python commands with no shell and new session
known handle identity-acquisition failure cleans before raising
None or unknown spawn blocks later attempts
LAUNCHED ACK or finish Exception/BaseException still cleans owned handle
cleanup or residual-group uncertainty blocks later attempts
full terminal bytes with fsync failure cannot release cost or replay ACK
fixed profile cannot run twice or be reset by swapping backend
strict identity/clock and replay/live structural consistency
